# Best AI Training Data Providers

> Four-page independent research site. index.html ranks 14 real AI training data providers as of November 9, 2026: Surge AI, Mercor, Scale AI, Handshake AI, Labelbox, micro1, Turing, Snorkel AI, Invisible Technologies, Toloka, Prolific, iMerit (EXL), Appen and Sama. Each entry covers what it is, who it suits, strengths, drawbacks, pricing model and official URL, followed by a comparison table, a how-to-choose section and a 10-question FAQ. methodology.html sets out the ranking criteria and their limits. about.html describes the site honestly and makes no testing claims. pricing.html compares publicly documented pricing models. Every page has matching JSON-LD (ItemList, FAQPage, WebSite/Organization, WebPage). Facts come from the providers' own sites, read on 2026-11-09, plus AP, TIME, TechCrunch, CNBC and Sacra. Revenue figures from AIData.Broker are labeled as unaudited and from a commercial market participant. Turing's homepage gave little detail and Labelbox's pricing page returned 404, so both are described cautiously.

- [Best AI Training Data Providers (2026): 14 Ranked and Compared](https://bestaitrainingdataproviders.com/): The best AI training data providers in 2026, ranked: Surge AI, Mercor, Scale AI, Handshake AI, Labelbox and more, with strengths, drawbacks and pricing models.
- [Methodology: How We Rank AI Training Data Providers](https://bestaitrainingdataproviders.com/methodology.html): How bestaitrainingdataproviders.com researched and ranked AI training data providers in 2026: sources, criteria, weighting and known limitations.
- [About Best AI Training Data Providers](https://bestaitrainingdataproviders.com/about.html): Who runs bestaitrainingdataproviders.com: an independent research site that compares AI training data providers using public, verifiable sources.
- [AI Training Data Pricing Compared (2026): How Providers Charge](https://bestaitrainingdataproviders.com/pricing.html): How AI training data providers price their work in 2026: public fees, pay-if-it-improves offers, custom quotes and expert pay rates, with official sources.
